Package com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.commands

package com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.commands
Concrete command definitions.

If a command has no other supporting classes it exists by itself here within this package, otherwise a sub-package is made to encapsulate everything related to that specific command.
